Apply to MUSC
Test Score Submission
Applicants are responsible for taking the entrance test(s) required by their program.
Test score results must be sent directly by the testing service. Photocopies of score reports are not acceptable. Scores reported on transcripts are not acceptable.
Arrange to take the test your program requires and provide your testing agency with the proper test code for MUSC.
Scores we receive cannot be returned to you or forwarded to other institutions.
Test agencies usually take up to four weeks to report your scores. We receive scores in batches from testing agencies on a periodic basis and cannot download individual scores.
Test
Code
Graduate Management Test (GMAT)
5407
Graduate Record Examination (GRE)
5407
Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL)
5407
To be considered for admission, official test scores should be sent directly to MUSC's Enrollment Management office with the following program-specific exceptions.
Program
Test
Code
Master of Science in Medical Sciences
Test scores are optional. Email unofficial MCAT or DAT scores to enrollment management OR if you have applied to the MUSC College of Medicine or Dental Medicine in the past year, your scores will be obtained from your AMCAS or AADSAS.
Doctor of Dental Medicine
Test scores must be sent to AADAS
85
Doctor of Medicine and Medical Scientist Training Program (M.D., Ph.D.)
Test scores must be sent to AMCAS
165
Doctor of Physical Therapy
Test scores must be sent to PTCAS
7338
